extracted.intended_audience: petitioners, patent owners, counsel, and PRPS users who will file or respond to AIA reviews via USPTO PTAB E2E
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and technical guidance for creating accounts, preparing petitions/responses, uploading documents, submitting fees, and searching AIA review cases in the USPTO PTAB E2E system (replacement for PRPS) for IPR, CBM, and PGR filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preferred browser
rubrics_metrics.description: PTAB E2E utilizes a web browser; Google Chrome is the preferred browser.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Google Chrome for best compatibility with the PTAB E2E web-based filing wizard and interfaces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing wizard for metadata and PDF upload
rubrics_metrics.description: PTAB E2E provides a filing wizard to assist petitioners and patent owners to provide metadata and upload pdf documents to the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare required metadata and PDF documents in advance; the wizard guides users through steps such as patent verification, petition info, claims challenged, and document upload.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial submission interface
rubrics_metrics.description: PTAB E2E provides an interface to the USPTO next generation financial system for submitting necessary fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the integrated financial system (Financial Manager) to submit fees; a RAM option is available only when FM is not available. Payment receipts will be generated through the system.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRPS → PTAB E2E migration schedule and availability
rubrics_metrics.description: PRPS will be unavailable from 12:01 a.m. (EST) Saturday, July 9th; PTAB E2E planned deployment target July 9 with go-live Monday, July 11, 2016. At 5:00 a.m. (EST) on Monday, July 11th AIA Reviews (IPR, PGR, CBM) will be available in PTAB E2E.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All AIA reviews of these trial types will be migrated to PTAB E2E and available in search and on counsel dockets. Derivations (DER) will continue in PRPS until later migration in 2016; only DER will be available in PRPS during the migration window.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRPS user profile email requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: PRPS users should ensure that their user profile in PRPS is updated with a unique email address associated with their name and USPTO Registration number; not another individual's name or a shared email address.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This email address will be linked with other USPTO systems and will become the user identification when logging into USPTO systems. PTAB E2E may later accommodate multiple email addresses for notifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account requirement for filing/responding
rubrics_metrics.description: The petitioner and the patent owner must create an account (unless one already exists) to login to PTAB E2E to file a petition or to respond to a petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anonymous users may access PTAB E2E to do basic searches for petitions and public documents, but cannot file or respond without an account.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expect defects; iterative improvement (Agile development)
rubrics_metrics.description: PTAB E2E is being developed using Agile Methodology; defects will exist in the system and will be prioritized and fixed in upcoming deployments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PTAB is committed to continuously improving the e-filing process with a focus on user experience. Users should report issues and provide feedback to help prioritize fixes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support and feedback channels
rubrics_metrics.description: Support will be available at 571-272-7822 and feedback/issues should be emailed to PTABE2EAdmin@uspto.gov. More information is at www.uspto.gov/ptab.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the listed phone, email, and website to report problems, ask questions, and submit user feedback about PTAB E2E functionality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify patent during petition creation
rubrics_metrics.description: The petition creation process includes a step to verify the patent (slide: 'Create Petition – Verify Patent').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the wizard's patent verification step to confirm the target patent information before proceeding with petition details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide petition information
rubrics_metrics.description: The petition creation workflow includes entering petition-level information (slide: 'Create Petition – Petition Info').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete petition metadata fields as prompted by the filing wizard prior to document upload and payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify claims challenged
rubrics_metrics.description: The petition requires specifying which claims are being challenged (slide: 'Create Petition – Claims Challenged').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List and identify each challenged claim in the petition as prompted; ensure accuracy to avoid procedural issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Upload petition documents
rubrics_metrics.description: The filing process includes uploading petition documents (slide: 'Create Petition – Petition Docs' and 'Petition Documents, Continued').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare all required PDF documents beforehand and upload them via the wizard; observe any system file-type or size requirements (user should consult the system for details).

rubrics_metrics.name: Document availability declaration
rubrics_metrics.description: The petition workflow includes a document availability step (slide: 'Petition – Document Availability').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate the availability status of documents (public, redacted, confidential, etc.) as required by the wizard; ensure proper handling of sealed or confidential materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify real party in interest
rubrics_metrics.description: The wizard includes steps for entering the real party in interest and any additional real parties (slides: 'Create Petition – Real Party', 'Real Party - Continued', 'Create Petition, Additional Real Party').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide accurate real-party-in-interest information and disclose additional real parties as required by AIA rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enter counsel information
rubrics_metrics.description: The filing process includes entering counsel information (slide: 'Create Petition - Counsel').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide counsel names, contact information, and USPTO registration numbers as prompted; ensure correspondence data is correct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review before submission
rubrics_metrics.description: The wizard provides review steps prior to final submission (slides: 'Create Petition - Review' and 'Review - Continued').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Carefully review all entered metadata, uploaded documents, fee selections, and party information before finalizing the filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment workflow and receipts
rubrics_metrics.description: The system includes payment screens (slides: 'Payment – Financial Manager', 'Payment – RAM – only when FM is not available', 'Payment Receipt', 'Payment Receipt, Continued').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete fee payment via Financial Manager when available; use RAM only as fallback. Confirm and retain payment receipts generated by the system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entering appearance as patent owner
rubrics_metrics.description: There is a specific step to 'Enter Appearance as Patent Owner' in the system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Patent owners must file an appearance through the system when responding to a petition to ensure docketing and notifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select the AIA review type
rubrics_metrics.description: Users must select the type of AIA review to file (slide: 'Select the AIA Review').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose the correct trial type (IPR, CBM, PGR) during petition creation to ensure proper routing and handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: All appearances listing
rubrics_metrics.description: The system contains an 'All Appearances' view (slide: 'All Appearances').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this view to verify which counsel/parties have entered appearances on the docket and to confirm representation status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search capability for petitions and public documents
rubrics_metrics.description: PTAB E2E includes a search interface to find petitions and public documents (slides: 'PTAB E2E Search').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anonymous users can perform basic searches; logged-in users/counsel should verify their docketed cases are visible after migration.
